title.narrative: Effective domestic revenue mobilisation for inclusive growth

description.narrative: The Overall Objective (Impact) of this action is to increase domestic revenue mobilisation in Guatemala. The Specific(s) Objective(s) (Outcomes) of this action are: (1) Improved voluntary tax compliance; (2) Strengthened governance and transparency of Tax Administration; and (3) Strengthened institutional capacity for revenue mobilisation oversight.

title.narrative: 2.2.1 Percentage of key SAT TCF processes reegineered and institutionally established

description.narrative: 2.2.1 Percentage of key SAT TCF processes reegineered and institutionally established

comment.narrative: A process mapping was formulated and a fivephase TCF model was shared along with a process flow for risk identification and another for risk analysis including a flow for the risk assessment activity used in the workshops. None of these processes or flows have been institutionally implemented to date. IFI is expected to formalize the methodology for the risk assessment activity in November 2024. Consequently the progress is 0 when considering the level of formalization. However if considering the level of conceptualization based on the referenced matrix the estimated progress is 23 7 out of 30 dimensions related to the processes.
